rag.name: univ_eq_singleton_of_card_one
rag.content:
theorem univ_eq_singleton_of_card_one {α} [Fintype α] (x : α) (h : Fintype.card α = 1) :
    (univ : Finset α) = {x} := by
  symm
  apply eq_of_subset_of_card_le (subset_univ {x})
  apply le_of_eq
  simp [h, Finset.card_univ]

namespace WickContraction

open FieldSpecification HepLean.List FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra FieldStatistic

variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification} {n : ℕ} (c : WickContraction n)
informal_statement: For any two elements \( i \) and \( j \) in a finite set where \( i < j \), any element \( a \) of the singleton set \(\{i, j\}\) must be equal to the set \(\{i, j\}\) itself.
informal_proof: Assume \( a \) is an element of the singleton set \(\{i, j\}\). By the definition of membership in a singleton set, \( a \) must be exactly the set \(\{i, j\}\). Therefore, \( a = \{i, j\} \).

id.name: WickContraction.of_singleton_eq
id.content:
lemma of_singleton_eq {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) (a : (singleton hij).1) :
    a = ⟨{i, j}, mem_singleton hij⟩ := by
  have ha2 := a.2
  rw [@mem_singleton_iff] at ha2
  exact Subtype.coe_eq_of_eq_mk ha2
